trending.title: Europe’s satellite merger tests drive for space independence
trending.body: The three-way deal aims to strengthen Europe’s satellite industry as Elon Musk’s Starlink sets the pace in low Earth orbit. It could also leave the EU with fewer suppliers for its own secure communications network.

trending.title: US renews push for EU to soften Big Tech rules
trending.body: Washington is again linking tariff relief for European steel exports to a demand that Brussels go easy on enforcing the Digital Markets Act.

trending.title: EU faces growing pressure to plug Ukraine’s Starlink gap
trending.body: European lawmakers have been calling on Brussels to fast-track Ukraine’s access to the bloc’s satellite capabilities.

trending.title: Starlink still restricted for Ukraine despite Trump saying Musk lifted speed limits
trending.body: Although some Ukrainian drone pilots have reported a marked improvement, there are still “constant connection interruptions.”

trending.title: Ukrainian officers warn Starlink slowdown ‘comparable to a nuclear strike against us’
